card.name: Words just before yielding or allowing something
card.fires_on: Small words (they, not, that, you, and) or verbs like submitting and sacrifice, in a sentence where a bad outcome, giving in or letting something happen is about to be stated.

modes.label: Blame and fault clauses
modes.description: Words after 'believe that' or 'if you fail to' just before a stated cause or loss.
modes.example: Many victims of domestic violence believe that<< they>> have created or caused the problems that led

modes.label: Giving in or giving up
modes.description: Verbs or links in sentences about submitting, sacrificing or consigning something.
modes.example: When our newspapers would not publish the Danish Mohammed cartoons, our newspapers were<< submitting>> to the demands of Sharia law.

modes.label: Security warnings
modes.description: Words in web-safety advice just before something is shared or exposed.
modes.example: Protect your identity and do<< not>> share your password with anyone or display it

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words about conceding, accepting, surrendering and allowing.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in warnings or arguments just before something is given up, conceded or allowed.
